chapter: Building the band, Ivie Anderson and touring
title: Talking back to Ivie Anderson on stage
summary: Greer begins ad-libbing to Ivie and makes her a hit; he also teases Milton Berle.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Chicago, so in the meantime at the Cotton Club, I used to do a lot of talking back to Ethel Waters. She was in the show at the Cotton Club. She used to sing different songs, and I would do a lot of adlib conversation with her and it was a terrific hit, you know, so we went down and we did the first show with Ivie and she just got a nice sympathetic hand, nothing spontaneous. So she come off and she was crying and so Irving Mills, he was very understanding.

So when I come off the stage, he say, 'Sonny, why don't you talk back to her, during her numbers like you used to do with Ethel Waters at the Cotton Club.' The next show, I think it would be fine, but don't tell her, because it would look like it was rehearsed. Just make it adlib. Just say anything.

So the second show when she come out, she was singing a song, I recall, real good, 'I'm a Little Blackbird, for Bluebird too' that was the opening number. She come out there and she sing 'I'm a little Blackbird Looking for a Bluebird, too,' and in back of all them drums, I raised up and say 'Don't look no further, baby, I'm right here.'

And the house caved. It shocked her so much, she damn near forgot the lyrics, so the house caved in and from then on she never looked back. Standing ovation. You know, each show was different. I never said the same thing twice. It wasn't no set routine. I said anything that come in my mind, you know, to fit the thing. And she was so surprised and

Irving Mills was surprised and it was a feature, the people ate it up, and from then on we were just like ham and eggs, Ivie and I. No matter was song she sang, I always had something to say to her, like what Bob Hope is doing it now. Current events, any kind of event come off, I would slide it in there.
